She went up. Mom went down. Dad went up. Dad went down. Mom went up. Mom went down. Stop, she said. Up and down, said Dad.

2-35.title: The Little Dragon
2-35.fullText: Stage two. More pattern stories. A! The Little Dragon! This story is called The Little Dragon. Written by Roderick Hunt and illustrated by Alex Brickda. When you hear this sound, turn the page. Now open the book. Let's read the story together. The children put on a play. I am the king, said Chip. Fight the dragon. I am the knight, said Wilma. I will fight the dragon. I am the dragon, said Kipper. But I am a little dragon. Wow! I'm the princess, said Biff. I like dragons. The princess played with the dragon. They played under the tree. I am the knight, said Wilma. I am frightened, said the dragon. Cross, said the princess. She pushed the knight in the pond. Good play, said everyone.
